style: two monologues of over two minutes

context.objective: Document how we carry out Payment Execution & Callback Verification Controls, the controls and what needs confirmation.

turns.text: To begin with, we open and classify the payment, that is done by Payment Preparer, what we do: create or update the payment in the payments log, where the payments log has these fields: record the documented payee, amount, purpose, entity, requested value date, and payment folder reference. Set the correct current status. Determine whether the instructions are new or changed. If they are, a callback is required. The check on it. Every payment must follow the payments log and status process. Next, we confirm the required client or entity approvals. That is done by Payment Preparer, what we do: for United States, U.S. payments, obtain client approval before release. For European payments, identify the applicable GP Fund Solutions, GPFS, regulated approval sequence under for regulated entities. Complete the required capital adequacy check, confirming that the entity has the required financial resources, where applicable. The check on it. Complete the applicable client or regional approval before release. After that, we perform callback for new or changed details. That is done by Callback Performer, what we do: obtain the phone number from an approved source independent of the request, not from the instruction email. Call the known contact. Confirm the contact's name and relationship to the counterparty. Verify the IBAN and SWIFT bank code for a European payment, or the ABA routing number for a United States payment. Also verify any other applicable account information. Record performer, contact, relationship, date, and time. Keep only the masked bank details allowed by Section 7. Compare the payee name with the account holder name. The check on it. Independently sourced callback, name match, only the permitted masked details are kept. Then we complete payment, duplicate, and screening checks. That is done by Payment Preparer Reviewer, what we do: compare the invoice or payment documents with the amount, payee, purpose, and entity. Check whether the payment is a duplicate. Complete required Exiger screening for sanctions and high-risk countries. Send any potential high-risk country match to two signatory A, SIG A, approvers. Complete United Kingdom, UK, construction industry scheme, CIS, supplier verification where applicable. The check on it. Do not release the payment while a screening result or possible duplicate is unresolved.
Once the checks and required approvals are clear, who actually releases the payment?

Once that is done, we confirm funding, timing, and foreign exchange, FX, that is done by payment preparer treasury. What we do: save a bank statement screenshot showing the balance, confirm sufficient funds for the payment and non-pending obligations, confirm the bank cutoff time and value date, arrange foreign exchange, FX, when required. If funds are insufficient, set status to insufficient funds and route to the check on it. Sufficient funds are available. The cutoff time and value date are confirmed. Foreign exchange is addressed. Following that, we input and obtain dual approval. That is done by payment preparer, signatory one, signatory two. What we do: enter the payment in the bank platform for review, update status to payment input for review or the applicable current status, obtain signatory one approval, obtain independent signatory two approval, complete any requirement for two signatory approvals, schedule or release the payment with sufficient time before the bank cutoff. The check on it: both required signatories and any specialist signatories have approved. Following that, we monitor settlement and handle exceptions. That is done by payment preparer treasury. What we do: monitor payment status, update the payment log from in progress to settled, or use pending query or not paid by GPFS as applicable, investigate rejects, returns, and pending queries, verify the instructions again before resubmitting with changed details. The check on it: the payment log status matches the bank platform's final status. Following that, we file records and obtain senior sign-off. That is done by payment preparer, an assistant fund controller, AFC or higher signs off. What we do: file the approval, callback, screening, balance, payment, and final bank status records in the digital binder or payment folder, confirm the payment log references the folder, obtain sign-off from an assistant fund controller, AFC, or higher that the records are complete. The check on it: an assistant fund controller, AFC, or higher confirms the post-payment records are complete.
What event or input normally prompts the Payment Preparer to open and classify a payment?

topics.answer: Payment Execution & Callback Verification Controls
The described work executes and monitors payments with verification, approvals and documented post-payment records.

The initiating event, recipient or detection, normal cadence and any fixed deadlines beyond the bank cutoff remain unestablished.
The bank cutoff time and value date are confirmed, and the payment is scheduled or released with sufficient time before the cutoff.

The payment log must match the bank platform's final status, and an AFC or higher confirms that the post-payment records are complete. The log can show settled, pending query or not paid by GPFS as applicable.

The Payment Preparer opens and classifies the payment, creates or updates its log entry, and confirms required client or entity approvals.
A Callback Performer carries out callbacks for new or changed payment details. Payment Preparer Reviewer performs the payment, duplicate and screening checks.
The role accountable for the overall payment result has not been identified; the AFC or higher signs off on record completeness.

The Payment Preparer opens and classifies the payment, creates or updates the payments log with documented payee, amount, purpose, entity, requested value date and payment-folder reference, sets the current status, and determines whether instructions are new or changed. A callback is required when they are new or changed.
The Payment Preparer confirms required approvals before release: for U.S. payments, obtain client approval; for European payments, identify the applicable GPFS regulated-entity approval sequence. Complete the capital adequacy check where applicable, confirming the entity has required financial resources, and complete the applicable client or regional approval before release.
For new or changed details, the Callback Performer obtains a phone number from an approved source independent of the request (not the instruction email), calls the known contact, confirms the contact's name and relationship to the counterparty, and verifies the applicable bank details. Verify IBAN and SWIFT bank code for European payments or ABA routing number for U.S. payments, plus other applicable account information. Record performer, contact, relationship, date and time, and retain only bank details masked as permitted by Section 7.
The Payment Preparer Reviewer compares invoice or payment documents with amount, payee, purpose and entity; checks for duplicates; completes required Exiger screening for sanctions and high-risk countries; and completes UK CIS supplier verification where applicable. A potential high-risk-country match is sent to two SIG A approvers. Do not release while a screening result or possible duplicate is unresolved.
After the payment checks, Payment Preparer Treasury saves a bank statement screenshot, confirms funds cover the payment and non-pending obligations, confirms cutoff and value date, and arranges FX when required. If funds are insufficient, the status is set to insufficient funds; the participant's routing instruction was incomplete.
The destination and subsequent handling of an insufficient-funds payment are unclear.
Payment Preparer, signatory one and signatory two handle bank input and dual approval: enter the payment for review, update its status, obtain signatory one and independent signatory two approvals and any required specialist approvals, then schedule or release before cutoff. The specific release actor is not assigned.
Payment Preparer Treasury monitors status, updates the log from in progress to settled or uses pending query or not paid by GPFS as applicable, and investigates rejects, returns and pending queries. Instructions are verified again before resubmission with changed details.
Payment Preparer files approval, callback, screening, balance, payment and final bank-status records in the digital binder or payment folder, confirms the log references the folder, and obtains AFC-or-higher sign-off that records are complete.

The reported callback controls are use of an independently sourced phone number, confirmation of contact name and relationship, comparison of payee name with account-holder name, and retention of only permitted masked bank details. Callback evidence recorded includes performer, contact, relationship, date and time.
Payment documents are compared with amount, payee, purpose and entity; duplicate and required Exiger sanctions/high-risk-country screening checks are performed. A potential high-risk-country match goes to two SIG A approvers, and release is blocked while screening or a possible duplicate is unresolved. UK CIS supplier verification is performed where applicable.
Payment Preparer Treasury checks sufficient funds for the payment and non-pending obligations, cutoff, value date and required FX. Both required signatories and any specialist signatories must approve; signatory two's approval is independent.
The payment log is checked against the bank platform's final status; an AFC or higher signs off that post-payment records are complete.

Reported conditional routes vary by payment region: U.S. payments require client approval before release and callback verification of the ABA routing number; European payments use the applicable regulated-entity approval sequence and callback verification of IBAN and SWIFT bank code. The source of these regional differences is not stated.
Capital adequacy checks apply where applicable, and UK CIS supplier verification is performed where applicable; the specific applicability conditions are not stated.
FX is arranged when required; insufficient funds produce an insufficient-funds status. Rejects, returns and pending queries are investigated, with instructions verified again before resubmission if details have changed.

The payments log records the documented payee, amount, purpose, entity, requested value date and payment-folder reference, and tracks status. Invoice or payment documents support comparison checks.
A bank statement screenshot records the balance. Approval, callback, screening, balance, payment and final bank-status records are filed in a digital binder or payment folder, which is referenced in the log.

The described work includes U.S. and European payment routes and UK CIS supplier verification where applicable.
Entity types, client applicability and whether the route is general GPFS practice remain unestablished.

Every payment must follow the payments log and status process; new or changed instructions require a callback. Applicable client or regional approval and capital adequacy checks must be completed before release.
For callback verification, use a phone number from an approved source independent of the instruction request, compare the payee name with the account-holder name, and retain only bank details masked as permitted by Section 7. Section 7 and the identity of the approved sources are not supplied here.
Do not release while a screening result or possible duplicate remains unresolved; potential high-risk-country matches are referred to two SIG A approvers.
The governing sources for the log, callback and approval requirements have not been identified.
How unresolved screening or duplicate results are cleared or escalated beyond the SIG A referral remains unspecified.
Required signatory approvals, including applicable specialist approvals, precede scheduling or release; instructions must be verified again before resubmitting with changed details.

The Payment Preparer Reviewer uses invoice or payment documents as inputs to payment comparison checks. Potential high-risk-country matches are sent to two SIG A approvers; the subsequent decision or handoff outcome is not stated.

Payment information and current status are created or updated in a payments log. The payment is entered in the bank platform for review, and its final bank status is compared with the log.
The payments log's software and storage location, and callback and approval tools, remain unidentified.

map.title: Payment Execution & Callback Verification Controls

steps.title: Open and classify payment
steps.description: Create or update the payment record, set its current status and determine whether instructions are new or changed. Every payment follows the log and status process.

steps.title: Confirm required approvals
steps.description: Obtain US client approval before release. For European payments, identify the applicable GPFS regulated approval sequence for regulated entities; complete the capital adequacy check where applicable and the applicable client or regional approval before release.

steps.title: Are instructions new or changed?
steps.description: Use the instruction classification established when opening the payment. A callback is required for new or changed instructions.

steps.title: Perform and record callback
steps.description: Obtain a telephone number from an approved source independent of the request, call the known contact and confirm their name and relationship. Verify the applicable bank identifiers and other account information, compare the payee and account-holder names, and retain only permitted masked details. European payments use IBAN and SWIFT bank code; US payments use ABA routing number.

steps.title: Check payment and duplicates
steps.description: Compare the invoice or payment documents with the amount, payee, purpose and entity, and check whether the payment is a duplicate. Do not release while a possible duplicate is unresolved.

steps.title: Screen payment in Exiger
steps.description: Complete required sanctions and high-risk country screening. An unresolved screening result blocks payment release.

steps.title: Send high-risk country match
steps.description: Send any potential high-risk country match to two signatory A approvers.

steps.title: Verify UK CIS supplier
steps.description: Complete UK construction industry scheme supplier verification where applicable.

steps.title: Confirm funding, timing and FX
steps.description: Save a bank statement screenshot showing the balance; check funds for the payment and non-pending obligations, bank cutoff and value date. Arrange FX when required.

steps.title: Record insufficient funds
steps.description: Set the status to insufficient funds. The participant's stated routing after this status is unclear.

steps.title: Input payment for review
steps.description: Enter the payment in the bank platform for review and update its status to payment input for review or the applicable current status.

steps.title: Obtain required signatory approvals
steps.actor: Payment Preparer, Signatory One, Signatory Two and any required specialist signatories
steps.description: Obtain signatory one approval and independent signatory two approval, and complete any requirement for two signatory approvals. Any required specialist signatories must also approve before release; their timing is UNKNOWN.

steps.title: Schedule or release payment
steps.actor: Payment Preparer, Signatory One, Signatory Two; individual releasing actor UNKNOWN
steps.description: Schedule or release the payment with sufficient time before the bank cutoff. Required client or regional and signatory approvals must be complete, and unresolved screening or possible duplicates block release.

steps.title: Monitor payment status
steps.description: Monitor payment status and identify rejects, returns or pending queries for investigation.

steps.title: Update payment log status
steps.description: Update the log from in progress to settled, or use pending query or not paid by GPFS as applicable. The log status must match the bank platform's final status.

steps.title: Investigate payment exceptions
steps.description: Investigate rejects, returns and pending queries. The resolution and subsequent handoff are UNKNOWN unless changed instructions require reverification before resubmission.

steps.title: Reverify changed instructions
steps.description: Verify the instructions again before resubmitting a payment with changed details. The reverification method is UNKNOWN.

steps.title: Resubmit changed payment
steps.description: Resubmit with changed details after the instructions have been verified again.

steps.title: File post-payment records
steps.system: Digital binder or payment folder; payments log
steps.description: File approval, callback, screening, balance, payment and final bank status records. Confirm that the payment log references the folder.

steps.title: Obtain senior record sign-off
steps.description: An assistant fund controller or higher signs off that the post-payment records are complete.
